Overall, the clinic has a very nice atmosphere. It's clean, smells nice, and feels relaxing. The reception staff are polite and friendly. The doctor is kind, speaks nicely, and provides excellent advice, making me feel comfortable during the treatment.

However, I would like the clinic to improve its communication regarding pricing with the sales staff, as it caused confusion and discomfort.

On the first consultation, the doctor estimated the orthodontic treatment at approximately 49,000 baht or less. However, after speaking with the sales staff, the price was quoted at 56,000 baht, with a 10,000 baht deposit required to guarantee the price. They also mentioned an additional 3,000 baht discount if booked that day.

Since I had previously consulted with other clinics, and the price was around 60,000 baht or less, and I intended to have the treatment done here, I decided to pay the deposit and took photos of the contract as proof.

However, about a week later, after the video assessment results came out... The salesperson called to inform me that the doctor's estimate was 61,300 baht and offered a discount, bringing the price down to 57,000 baht. They then called back to say there was an additional 1,000 baht discount, bringing the final price to 56,000 baht.

This is confusing because I don't know where the 3,000 baht discount mentioned during the deposit went. Initially, I understood the price to be 56,000 - 3,000 = 53,000 baht, as previously discussed.

Furthermore, I'm unsure whether the increased price, claimed to be the doctor's estimate, was genuinely from the doctor or due to a communication error. During the consultation, the doctor quoted a different price at a later time, leaving me confused about which information was final and correct.

Therefore, I'm concerned about the clarity and transparency of pricing information, especially after a deposit has been made.

Overall, I'm still very impressed with the doctor and the clinic's atmosphere. However, I hope the clinic will improve the clarity of pricing to build greater customer confidence. 🙂

❌Think carefully before getting braces here❌
For anyone considering this clinic, I recommend checking their system regarding assigned dentists and requesting written documentation confirming all costs before making a large payment. This will prevent you from having the same experience as me. Based on my actual experience, I had braces for 8 months.
1. The initial contact and payment process was excellent, but after that, I received absolutely no service. Even on the day the equipment was installed, no one discussed the treatment plan from beginning to end! No one offered any advice, and there was no assigned dentist. The dentists rotated constantly (I asked, and they said dentists frequently quit), so there was no consistent treatment plan.
2. On the day I received my Clear Aligners, I ordered sets 1-10. For sets 11-24, the staff said they would be delivered. When I inquired about set 8, the staff informed me of a 50 THB delivery fee. (I wasn't concerned about the money, but I felt like I paid almost 100,000 THB, and now I had to pay a 50 THB delivery fee!)
Regarding care: The initial care before payment was excellent, but once treatment began, there was no assigned dentist. The dentists changed constantly, making the treatment plan inconsistent. And the system only records the total amount paid, not the detailed treatment history.
3. On the day the braces were removed, we reported four issues. In summary, the doctor told us to accept it, saying he spent 300,000 baht on facial injections and this is all he got!!! And the issue of the teeth not aligning and being unable to chew is actually a basic requirement of orthodontics, but the doctor told us to just accept it! And the doctor said, "It's my mealtime now, but I'm doing you a favor!" We have gaps in our front teeth, with black spots from filing, even though they weren't there before treatment. We had to pay extra for fillings, even though they could have extended the treatment time. We had to pay an extra 4,000 baht for fillings! There was no responsibility taken; they only wanted us to pay more. The height of our lower front teeth was uneven because the Clear Aligner set 11-24 didn't fit properly, but no one could fix it. Then they claimed it was because the patient used their teeth to bite down on grains, causing erosion?! Honestly, why didn't they adjust the Clear Aligners to fit properly throughout the orthodontic treatment? They didn't care. After the treatment was finished, they just blamed us!!! Their work performance was a -0/10.
Result after treatment: Currently, the teeth don't align properly, chewing is more difficult, and there are gaps and black spots on the front teeth from filing. 1. The doctor informed me to accept the situation and refused to extend the treatment for further corrections. If I wanted corrections, I would have to pay an additional 4,000 baht for the filling.

4. Regarding the cashier: This time, I needed a crown (after root canal treatment). The employee informed me when I paid 14,000 baht that "You can get the crown next time you have treatment, there will be no additional cost." However, it turned out I had to pay an additional 16,000 baht. They claimed the employee misspoke! I asked to see the CCTV footage, but they said there were no cameras and the customer had to provide evidence! It was incredibly unfair. It felt like the treatment was incomplete, but I had to do it!
5. There were no receipts or appointment slips provided each time. The system lacked information about my doctor's visits, corrections, or procedures; only payment information was available. In short, the doctor is incompetent. Because doctors quit frequently.

For those considering this, I can give you this honest information. They actually took advantage of me even more, but I can't type it all out as it would make a very long review.

I want to share my 8-month clear aligner experience as a cautionary tale. If you are choosing a clinic, please double-check their doctor assignment system and get all price quotes in writing before making a big payment.
No Consistent Doctor & Poor Records: The sales pitch was great, but after-sales care was non-existent. There was no fixed doctor due to high staff turnover; dentists rotated constantly, destroying treatment continuity. The clinic's system only tracked payments, lacking detailed medical records or progress updates.

text:
Anyone wanting to get braces here needs to have some free time.

Initially, the x-ray and treatment plan discussion went well. The sales representative added me on Line and said the equipment would arrive before the 20th. There was no further contact until the 18th, when the clinic confirmed my appointment for the 19th at 2 PM. I had to quickly clear my schedule because the clinic said the doctor only had that many appointments available.

On the 19th, as scheduled, my case involved a fixed retainer, so it needed to be removed and the braces fitted. The doctor worked very quickly; they finished and immediately put on the braces. It seemed rushed, and the explanation was very short and concise, but I didn't mind. The quick finish was good, though.

However, upon returning home and having the braces removed, I found several issues. Glue was smudged between my teeth, making flossing impossible. My canine teeth were very sharp, likely also due to the glue. Finally, the fixed retainer wasn't removed properly; my previous dentist had made it too thick and stuck to my gums. It wasn't smooth at all; some teeth looked like lumps, as if the doctor hadn't checked the work properly. I had to pay extra for this. 😅

After adding the clinic's LINE account, it took a long time to get a response. When I finally got one, they told me to contact another LINE account, which was their supplier, but that was outside of business hours. I tried calling the clinic again, but no one answered. I called between 7:40 PM and 7:50 PM – I guess they'd all gone home. The next morning, I called between 10:10 AM and 10:15 AM, and still no one answered. It seems the clinic's phone only works for making calls, not receiving them. In the end, I had to schedule an appointment with the supplier via LINE again. The funny thing is, the admin said it was just glue residue that could be gently scraped off with a toothbrush or toothpick. If that were true, I would have done it myself! Finally, I got an appointment to fix the problem. Luckily, I didn't see the original doctor because they were very busy. I got a different doctor who was very nice, patient, and explained everything thoroughly.

In summary, if you plan to come here, be prepared for potentially slow service.

**The clinic contacted me about two weeks after this review to discuss the issues. The manager (or the person who contacted me) tried to resolve the problem by scheduling another appointment with the doctor, but it seems they don't quite understand that I want improvements to my experience in every aspect, starting from the initial contact and scheduling, not just at the clinic.**
I saw the doctor again for a check-up on my concerns. To summarize, regarding the old fixed retainer, the doctor intentionally left it a little loose, but this wasn't explained initially.
